svg.title: Field-relative: away from you means away from you
svg.desc: Animated. Two fields seen from above, the driver at the bottom of each. In both, the driver pushes the stick away from them while the robot turns half a turn. Left, field-relative, using the gyro, whose heading dial turns with the robot: the robot goes straight away from the driver the whole time, whichever way it faces. Right, robot-relative, skipping the gyro: forward is wherever the robot's front points, so the same push curves it around to the side and back toward the driver. Below: it needs the gyro heading to be right; a gyro that counts backwards, or a heading zeroed while the robot faced sideways, sends every push the wrong way; trying both is a quick way to tell a gyro problem from a module problem.
